summary: Independent review of the day-5-adult pulsed-SILAC SDRF (36 runs x 2 channels = 72 rows) found no blocking or important issues; values trace to the deposited MaxQuant search, raw method headers re-fetched from PRIDE FTP, the PRIDE record and the paper's Supplemental Experimental Procedures. Only minor findings remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh subagent with no producer transcript; did not read earlier review-* dirs; producer manifest treated as untrusted and re-checked against primary sources

spec_compliance.evidence: sdrf-tools contract -t ms-proteomics@1.1.0 -t invertebrates (released latest per templates.yaml): every SDRF column licensed, no required or recommended column missing; 40 columns, 72 rows, uniform width; repeated comment[sdrf template], comment[cleavage agent details] and comment[modification parameters] are multiple-cardinality columns; reserved words only 'not applicable' in cell type (allowed); patterns ok (30 NCE, 4.5 ppm, 0.5 Da, 400m/z-1500m/z, 6/24/48 hour); material type 'whole organism' is in the fixed enum; (source name, assay name, comment[label]) and (source, bio rep, tech rep, fraction) coordinates are unique.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 lookups: PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition, MS:1002416 Orbitrap Fusion, MS:1001251 Trypsin, MS:1001309 Lys-C, MS:1000422 beam-type collision-induced dissociation, PRIDE:0000608 Dithiothreitol (DTT), PRIDE:0000599 Iodoacetamide (IAA), MS:1000264 ion trap, UNIMOD:1 Acetyl, UNIMOD:35 Oxidation, UNIMOD:259 Label:13C(6)15N(2), UNIMOD:4 Carbamidomethyl - labels match exactly, none obsolete. Bare characteristics resolve: BTO:0001489 whole body, EFO:0001272 adult, PATO:0000461 normal, MONDO:0005180 Parkinson disease; SILAC light/heavy exist in PRIDE (PRIDE:0000326/0000325). sdrf-tools check: 17/17 verified, 0 UNIMOD swaps.

source_evidence.evidence: Re-fetched PRIDE v3 project (title matches, sample protocol: 6.5 mM DTT, 55 mM IAA, trypsin + Lys-C co-digest). Paper text identity asserted (Visscher et al., 'Proteome-wide Changes in Protein Turnover Rates in C. elegans Models of Longevity and Age-Related Disease'): strain list N2/CB1370/CF1038/DR1209/OW40/OW450 with genotypes verbatim; day 5 adults transferred into 3 wells (one per time point) and harvested at 6, 24, 48 h; HCD 30%, Top Speed DDA, ion-trap MS2. Independently range-fetched raw headers of 20160205_F1_RM_SH_OW40_6h_AF.raw and _WF.raw: instrument 'Orbitrap Fusion', MS1 Orbitrap 240K scan 400-1500, ActivationType HCD, CE 30 non-stepped, MS2 Detector IonTrap. MaxQuant oldworms mqpar.xml/parameters.txt (v1.5.2.8): Trypsin/P, fixed Carbamidomethyl (C), variable Acetyl (Protein N-term) + Oxidation (M), labelMods Lys8, multiplicity 2, mainSearchTol 4.5 ppm, ITMS 0.5 Da; experimentalDesign maps every run to the strain/time experiment and AF=fraction 1, WF=fraction 2.

file_mapping.evidence: PRIDE files/all re-fetched (85 files, projectAccessions all PXD004561; 82 .raw). The 36 comment[data file] values are exactly the 36 deposited 20160205_* raw files, all vendor .raw, each appears twice (light+heavy). Sibling developing SDRF has 32 files, 0 overlap with this one; 14 runs (20141107_F1_HRV_SM_B1-B7, C1-C7) remain unannotated by either and are disclosed as limitations.

design_consistency.evidence: 6 strains x 3 pulse times = 18 MaxQuant experiments, each with 2 fractions (AF/WF) and 2 SILAC channels = 72 rows; matches mqpar experiments/fractions and paper (one well per strain per time point, so biological replicate 1 is correct). Factor values (disease, genotype, sampling time) mirror characteristics; Parkinson disease is set only on OW40 rows 49-60; OW450 YFP control is normal.

omission_safety.evidence: No asserted value exceeds evidence: no fractionation method, age, sex or batch invented; AF/WF meaning left unstated; instrument choice (Fusion vs PRIDE's Fusion ETD) justified by raw header; deviations of the deposited search from paper prose (no deamidation, added Acetyl N-term, MQ 1.5.2.8) disclosed as limitations; unmappable B/C runs excluded rather than guessed.

deterministic_validation.evidence: flock ... parse_sdrf validate-sdrf --sdrf_file <artifact> --template ms-proteomics --template invertebrates: exit 0, 'Most seems to be fine. There were only warnings.' (only warnings: strain names not in NCBITaxon, a warning-level validator; TERMS.tsv types strain as free text). sdrf-tools check: exit 0 CLEAN. sdrf-tools score: exit 0, 100/100. Evidence manifest schema-check: valid. Separate single-template parse_sdrf runs were queued behind the shared lock and stopped; the union run covers both templates.

findings.message: AF/WF semantics are unknown; fraction 1/2 follows the MaxQuant experimental design only.
findings.evidence: Raw MS methods for OW40_6h_AF and _WF are identical apart from the method file name suffix '_NP_AF'; paper does not mention AF/WF. Correction criterion: if a source later defines AF/WF, add comment[fractionation method] or re-model.

findings.message: PRIDE lists Orbitrap Fusion ETD (MS:1002417); SDRF uses Orbitrap Fusion (MS:1002416).
findings.evidence: Raw header instrument name 'Orbitrap Fusion' and paper 'Orbitrap Fusion Tribrid'; choice is defensible and disclosed.

findings.message: 'adult' is less specific than the 'day 5 adult' stage in the paper; invertebrates template suggests WBls for C. elegans.
findings.evidence: Template validator accepts EFO; EFO:0001272 adult is valid.

findings.message: Pulsed SILAC: one worm population is split into _Lys0/_Lys8 source names.
findings.evidence: Representational choice documented in the manifest; label column already distinguishes channels.

findings.message: parse_sdrf warns that strain names are not NCBITaxon terms.
findings.evidence: Warning-level validator; TERMS.tsv types strain or breed as free text; CGC strain names are correct.
